靳兰玦一把推开方言，自己坐起来，才发现刚才狂打喷嚏，扯动了手背上的吊针。

针头滚落，鲜红的血珠一颗颗渗出来，手背在她的注视下慢慢肿成一个大白馒头。

靳兰玦：“……”

如果视线能杀人……

方言显然不觉得这与他有什么关系，当即就大呼小叫：

“兰兰！你怎么这么不小心？才刚醒来身体这么虚弱，你不要逞……”

“砰——”

他话没说完，就被人一下撞飞出去，砸在了病床一边的茶几上。

塑料桌腿与地面立刻划出刺耳的响声。

“兰兰！”

何秀芳一把抓住靳兰玦的双手，连同那枚要掉不掉的针头一起紧紧攥住。

靳兰玦痛得表情扭曲，立刻用力抽出自己的手。

果不其然，原本肿成白馒头的手背上，被扭曲的针头刺出两个鲜红的血洞。

这下滋滋冒血的洞有三个了。

何秀芳压根没注意靳兰玦的手，只是一脸哀伤地看着她，眼泪扑簌簌滚落：

“兰兰……你不要妈妈了吗？”

靳兰玦皱眉。

只是短短几天没见，何秀芳简直像换了个人一样。

面容枯槁，形容憔悴，看上去瘦了至少有五十斤！

原本的她，是个养尊处优的暴发户老婆，身形丰腴，满脸的胶原蛋白。

而现在，松垮发黄的皮肤皱巴巴垂落，眨眼间老了二十岁！

这比上一世她记忆中的何秀芳更瘦。

下意识地，她还是没忍住问了句：“你怎么了？”

何秀芳双眼一亮，立刻重新凑上来要握她的手。

靳兰玦立刻把手缩进被子里面，牢牢压在自己的屁股下面。

何秀芳失落地抹眼泪，期待着看着她：

“兰兰，你是个好孩子，你还是舍不得妈妈受苦的是不是？

你看妈妈变成这个样子，以后还怎么照顾你啊呜呜呜呜……”

靳兰玦听了半天没听出重点，不耐打断她：“有事说事。”

她停顿一下，像是想到了什么，问：“你是不是生什么病了？”

何秀芳立刻可怜巴巴地哭诉起来。

Jin Lanjue pushed Fang Yan away and sat up, only to realize that he had sneezed wildly and pulled the hanging needle on the back of his hand.

The needle rolled off, bright red blood seeped out one by one, and the back of her hand slowly swelled into a big white bun under her gaze.

Jin Lanjue: "..."

If sight could kill...

Fang Yan obviously didn't think this had anything to do with him, so he immediately yelled:

"Lan Lan! Why are you so careless? You just woke up and your body is so weak. Don't try..."

"Bang——"

Before he could finish his words, he was knocked out and hit the coffee table beside the hospital bed.

The plastic table legs and the ground immediately made a harsh sound.

"Lanlan!"

He Xiufang grabbed Jin Lanjue's hands and held the needle tightly.

Jin Lanjue's expression twisted in pain, and he immediately pulled out his hand with force.

Sure enough, the twisted needle pricked two bright red blood holes on the back of the hand that was originally swollen into a white bun.

Now there are three holes that are bleeding.

He Xiufang didn't pay attention to Jin Lanjue's hand at all. He just looked at her with a sad face, tears rolling down:

"Lanlan...you don't want your mother anymore?"

Jin Lanjue frowned.

After not seeing each other for just a few days, He Xiufang seemed like a different person.

His face was haggard, his appearance was haggard, and he looked like he had lost at least fifty pounds!

She was originally a pampered nouveau riche wife with a plump figure and a face full of collagen.

But now, the loose and yellow skin is wrinkled and drooping, and I have aged twenty years in the blink of an eye!

This was thinner than the He Xiufang she remembered in her previous life.

Subconsciously, she couldn't help but ask: "What's wrong with you?"

He Xiufang's eyes lit up and he immediately came up to hold her hand again.

Jin Lanjue immediately retracted his hand into the quilt and pressed it firmly under his buttocks.

He Xiufang wiped her tears in despair and looked at her expectantly:

"Lan Lan, you are a good child, but you still don't want your mother to suffer, right?

Look at mom like this, how will she take care of you in the future? Uuuuuuuu..."

Jin Lanjue listened for a long time without understanding the key point, so he couldn't bear to interrupt her: "You have something to say."

She paused, as if thinking of something, and asked, "Are you sick?"

He Xiufang immediately started crying pitifully.
